publications.name: Mineralogical Maps of Mars from Hapke Modeling and Spectral Unmixing
publications.summary: We constructed a Hapke-based framework to perform spectral unmixing in order to infer mineralogical maps of selected areas on Mars using CRISM data.

publications.name: A Study of Hyperspectral Clustering - How to Speed Up Spectral Unmixing of Moon Mineralogy Mapper Data
publications.summary: We use clustering algorithms as a means for speeding up the unmixing process on the lunar surface.

publications.name: Geomorphologic Feature Extraction and Clustering of Martian DTM Data
publications.summary: We present a new way of grouping elevation data based on geomorphologic properties for cartography.

publications.name: The Interaction Between Multiple Nanophase Iron Particles Changes the Slope of Lunar Reflectance Spectra
publications.summary: We analyzed the impact of particle interaction in lunar reflectance spectra.

publications.name: Space Weathering Simulation of Interacting Nanophase Iron Particles in the Thermal Infrared Region
publications.summary: We analyzed the implication of using particle clusters in the thermal infrared region and how the spectra change by considering absorbing properties.

publications.name: Localized Polarization Behavior and Inferred Grain Size Distribution at the Lunar Swirl Reiner Gamma in Comparison to Crater Rays and Ejecta Blankets
publications.summary: This study examines the regolith grain size distribution at the lunar swirl Reiner Gamma and nearby locations based on new telescopic polarimetric imaging data.

publications.name: Spectropolarimetric Properties of the Lunar Swirl Reiner Gamma and Western Oceanus Procellarum
publications.summary: This study discusses new telescopic multi-band spectropolarimetric imaging data of the lunar swirl Reiner Gamma and surrounding areas.

publications.name: Yet Another Scattering Framework: Simulation of Light Scattering Interaction Between Spherical Particles Using the T-Matrix
publications.summary: We developed a light scattering framework written in Python, emphasizing efficiency, scalability, ease of use, and modularity.
